title: Must be anchored to the wall
text: Must be anchored to the wall. Of course it's cheap - because, it's, well, cheap!  But it is so lightweight that it feels like it would topple over easily.  It needs to be attached to the wall, and brackets for that are included - I just didn't really want to do that.  If you have children in your home - make sure to attach it to the wall!  It looks ok, and will do for now, until I can find a heavier duty item.  I have a wrought iron one in the other bathroom that requires no assembly and sits firmly on the ground.  But, i bought it years ago and can't find another!  On the upside, this one was fairly easy to assemble, with directions that actually made some sense.  And it looks just like the picture.  I was able to assemble it all by myself with just a screwdriver.
